cohort: Patients who underwent emergency hysterectomies for different obstetrical indications during a one-year period.
finding: The study found that placenta previa increta was a major obstetrical complication, accounting for 21.2% of Caesarean hysterectomies, and was associated with multiparity and previous C-sections.
mod_finding: The study examines the frequency and outcomes of cesarean hysterectomies performed for placenta accreta, a serious obstetrical complication.
